chunks: He led me astray from the Warning after it had come to me. Satan always betrays man.

key_terms.الذِّكْرِ: The Reminder (referring to the Quran or divine message)
key_terms.خَذُولاً: A betrayer/ally who supports in misguidance

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between Satan and humans according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Furqan underscores the definitive nature of Satan's betrayal, illustrating how he actively diverts believers from the 'Dhikr' (divine reminder) once it has been clearly presented. It serves as a cautionary reminder that while Satan is a distinct entity, his promise of aid is ultimately hollow, reinforcing the need for steadfast adherence to divine guidance amidst spiritual trials.
